subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should this grouped update be accepted after direct source review of the credential-bearing actions—especially `openai/codex-action`—and exact-head workflow proof?
rationale: The diff is mechanically narrow but changes third-party executable code that receives high-value credentials, and repository policy requires a human security-boundary decision plus direct Codex contract inspection before approval.

options.title: Verify and land the batch
options.body: Rebase, inspect each upstream pin and the sibling Codex contract, then merge only after exact-head security and representative credentialed workflow checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate token, registry, Codex, and security-scanning actions from lower-risk toolchain pins so each credential boundary can be reviewed and rolled back independently.

options.title: Regenerate later
options.body: Pause or close this branch and allow Dependabot to regenerate a clean current-main batch if access errors and repeated rebases continue.

recommendation.title: Verify and land the batch
recommendation.body: Rebase, inspect each upstream pin and the sibling Codex contract, then merge only after exact-head security and representative credentialed workflow checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-workflow history and official repository ownership make this the strongest available owner for the security and release decision.
